_readme: First read of American River College's program maps (S345, SkyLantern). The census reads Los Rios homepages as 404 (lesson 13) while their deeper pages answer. A web search (2026-10-08) found program maps pages on the Los Rios colleges' own sites: each map gives a 'semester-to-semester course recommendation', with Cal-GETC and Local GE versions of many degrees, as PDFs on mapmaker.losrios.edu (the district's domain). The search found no ARC program maps page; ARC's Academics page lists Program Roadmaps and a Degree Planner. This read loads the Academics page and follows the roadmap link.

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map, and in what form (a page, a PDF, an interactive tool).
questions.map_shape: How one map names its terms and lists its courses, read on one map the index links.
